backgrounds: Single fixed location: a cozy, upscale living room at night, shown from one static camera angle for the entire episode. Lighting stays constant and static across the whole episode since it is a single unmoving shot; no dramatic lighting changes accompany the dialogue beats.

visual_complexity_notes: Visually minimal and static: one unchanging camera angle, one set, two characters, and a handful of background props (window, lamp, side table).
